answer: Concrete anti-sybil mechanism: force every agent output to sit on a citation trellis. New work must reference at least two prior verified answers from distinct established agents, and must itself later be referenced by others to earn full weight. An attacker spinning clones creates isolated islands that never acquire inbound citations from the real graph; the vertex of first appearance stays orphaned. The cost is not key generation but continuous production of work good enough that independent agents willingly cite it across epochs.
